paragraphs: The Corporation was incorporated under the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia) on October 10, 2025 under the name 1559985 B.C. Ltd. and changed its name to Brookfield Business Corporation on March 27, 2026. Our head office is located at 225 Liberty Street, 8th Floor, New York, NY 10281-1048 and its registered office is located at 1055 West Georgia Street, 1500 Royal Centre, P.O. Box 11117, Vancouver, British Columbia V6E 4N7. The Class A Shares are listed on the NYSE and the TSX under the symbol "BBUC". On March 27, 2026, pursuant to the Arrangement (i) holders of BBU units and BBUC exchangeable shares received 1 Class A Share for each unit and BBUC exchangeable share held and (ii) the Redemption-Exchange Units and Special LP Units of Holding LP were exchanged, on a one-for-one basis, for Class A Shares and Special Shares, respectively. As of the date of this Form 20-F, Brookfield holds 100% of the Class B Shares and 100% of the Special Shares and Brookfield Holders hold approximately 69% of our Class A Shares.

The Corporation carries on its business through BBU and Holding LP. There was no substantive change to the business of our group in connection with the Arrangement. Our group continues to serve as Brookfield's primary public vehicle to own and operate business services and industrial operations on a global basis, with a focus on high-quality operations that benefit from a strong competitive position and provide essential products and services. The Corporation will seek to build value through enhancing the cash flows of our businesses, pursuing an operations-oriented acquisition strategy and opportunistically recycling capital generated from operations and dispositions into our existing operations and new acquisitions. Like BBU, the Corporation's goal is to generate returns to security holders primarily through capital appreciation with a modest distribution yield.

BBU was established by Brookfield Corporation as its primary vehicle to own and operate business services and industrial operations on a global basis. On June 20, 2016, Brookfield Corporation completed the spin-off of its business services and industrial operations to BBU, which was effected by way of a special dividend of BBU units to holders of Brookfield Corporation's Class A and B limited voting shares. Each holder of the shares received one BBU unit for every 50 shares, representing approximately 45% of BBU units, with Brookfield retaining the remaining BBU units. Prior to the spin-off, Brookfield effected a reorganization so that our then-current operations were held by the Holding Entities, the common shares of which are wholly-owned by Holding LP. In consideration, Brookfield received a combination of BBU units, GP Units, Redemption-Exchange Units of the Holding LP and Special LP Units. The BBU General Partner is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Corporation. On March 27, 2026, BBU completed the Arrangement. BBU is now a subsidiary of the Corporation, will be delisted and will cease to be a reporting issuer.

On March 15, 2022, BBU completed the special distribution of BBUC exchangeable shares of BBHC. Each of BBU's unitholders of record on March 7, 2022 received one BBUC exchangeable share for every two LP units held. Pursuant to the Arrangement, BBHC is now a subsidiary of the Corporation, will be delisted and will cease to be a reporting issuer.
The following table outlines significant transactions and events that transpired in our business since January 1, 2025:
Date Segment Event January 2025 Industrials

In January 2025, our advanced energy storage operation raised $5 billion of new first lien debt. $4.5 billion of the proceeds were used to fund a special distribution to owners, of which our share was approximately $1.2 billion.
On January 16, 2025, our offshore oil services completed the sale of its shuttle tanker operation for consideration of $484 million, resulting in a net gain of $214 million.

On January 30, 2025, together with institutional partners, we completed the acquisition of Chemelex, a leading manufacturer of electric heat tracing systems, through a carve-out from a larger industrial corporation. Total consideration was $1.7 billion, funded with equity and subsidiary debt financing. Our economic ownership interest in the business is 26%, and our share of the equity investment was $212 million.

On May 26, 2025, our healthcare services operation entered receivership due to an event of default under its credit agreement after unsuccessful efforts to negotiate with key stakeholders on a sustainable long-term solution for the business. Following the appointment of a receiver and transition of oversight of the operations, we ceased to have control of the business and deconsolidated the net liabilities of the business, and recorded a pre-tax net gain of $236 million in the consolidated statements of operating results, included in other income (expense), net.
Brookfield Business Corporation May 2025 Industrials

On May 27, 2025, we completed the acquisition of Antylia Scientific, a leading manufacturer and distributor of critical consumables and testing equipment serving life sciences and environmental labs for total consideration of $1.3 billion, of which our share of equity was $168 million for a 26% economic interest. We have accounted for our interest in the business as an equity accounted investment.

On July 1, 2025, we completed the merger of our returnable plastic packaging operation with a North American packaging solutions provider. We deconsolidated the net assets of the returnable plastic packaging operation and recognized an equity accounted investment of $180 million representing a 45% interest in the merged business, of which our economic ownership interest is 10%.

On March 27, 2026, the Arrangement was completed, following which the partnership became a subsidiary of the Corporation.

The partnership was established by Brookfield to be its flagship public partnership for its business services and industrial operations. Our operations are primarily located in the United States, Europe, Australia, Brazil, and Canada. We are focused on owning and operating high-quality operations that benefit from a strong competitive position and provide essential products and services. We seek to build value through enhancing the cash flows of our businesses, pursuing an operations oriented acquisition strategy and opportunistically recycling capital generated from operations and dispositions into our existing operations, new acquisitions and investments. paragraphs: 本公司係依加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省商業公司法於2025年10月10日成立，公司名稱為1559985 B.C. Ltd.，並於2026年3月27日更名為Brookfield Business Corporation。本公司總部位於紐約州紐約市Liberty Street 225號8樓，郵遞區號10281-1048；註冊辦公室則位於加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省溫哥華市West Georgia Street 1055號1500 Royal Centre，郵遞區號P.O. Box 11117，V6E 4N7。A類股於紐約證券交易所及多倫多證券交易所上市，代號為"BBUC"。2026年3月27日，根據協議，(i) 持有BBU單位及BBUC可轉換股的股東，每持有1單位及1BBUC可轉換股，可獲發1股A類股；(ii) Holding LP的Redemption-Exchange Units及Special LP Units則按1:1比例轉換為A類股及Special Shares。截至本20-F表格填報日，Brookfield持有100%的B類股及100%的Special Shares，而Brookfield Holders持有約69%的A類股。

本公司透過BBU及Holding LP進行業務。與協議相關的業務無重大變動。我們的集團持續作為Brookfield擁有並經營全球性商業服務及工業業務的主要公開載體，專注於具高品質且擁有強競爭優勢的業務，提供必要的產品與服務。本公司將透過提升業務現金流、採行以營運為導向的收購策略，以及適時地將營運及處分所產生的資金重新投入現有業務與新收購，來建立價值。與BBU一樣，本公司目標是以資本增值為主要方式，提供投資人回報，並搭配小幅的現金股息收益率。

BBU係由Brookfield Corporation設立，作為其擁有並經營全球性商業服務及工業業務的主要載體。2016年6月20日，Brookfield Corporation完成將其商業服務及工業業務分拆至BBU，此分拆透過向Brookfield Corporation A類及B類有限投票股股東發放BBU單位的特別股息方式進行。每持有50股股份的股東，可獲發1個BBU單位，代表約45%的BBU單位，Brookfield則保留剩餘的BBU單位。分拆前，Brookfield進行重組，使當時的業務由Holding Entities持有，這些Holding Entities的普通股全由Holding LP持有。作為對價，Brookfield獲取BBU單位、GP Units、Holding LP的Redemption-Exchange Units及Special LP Units。BBU的普通合夥人為本公司的全資子公司。2026年3月27日，BBU完成協議。BBU現為本公司子公司，將從股市除牌，並停止作為報告發行人。
2022年3月15日，BBU完成向BBHC發放BBUC可轉換股的特別分紅。2022年3月7日為記錄日的BBU單位持有人，每持有2個LP單位，可獲發1個BBUC可轉換股。根據協議，BBHC現為本公司子公司，將從股市除牌，並停止作為報告發行人。
以下表格列出了自2025年1月1日起，本公司業務的重要交易與事件：

2025年1月，本公司先進能源儲存業務籌集了50億美元的新一級貸款。其中45億美元用於特別分紅，本公司所分得的金額約為12億美元。
2025年1月16日，本公司離岸油服務業務完成出售其穿梭油輪業務，交易金額為484百萬美元，產生淨收益214百萬美元。
於 2025 年 1 月 30 日，本公司與機構夥伴共同完成對 Chemelex 的收購，Chemelex 為電熱追蹤系統的領導製造商，該收購為從較大型工業公司中分拆而出。總交易金額為 1.7 十億美元，以股本及子公司債務融資支付。本公司在該業務的經濟權益為 26%，本公司在該權益投資中的份額為 212 百萬美元。
於 2025 年 5 月 26 日，本公司醫療服務運營部門因未能與關鍵股東就業務的可持續長遠解決方案進行成功協商，而因信用協議下的違約事件進入接管程序。在任命接管人並轉移對運營的監督後，本公司不再控制該業務，並對該業務的淨負債進行去合併，並在合併財務狀況表的營運成果中記錄了 236 百萬美元的預稅淨收益，包含於其他收入（費用），淨額中。
Brookfield 商業公司 2025 年 5 月 工業
於 2025 年 5 月 27 日，本公司完成對 Antylia Scientific 的收購，Antylia Scientific 為服務生命科學及環境實驗室的關鍵消耗品及測試設備的領導製造商與分銷商，總交易金額為 1.3 十億美元，本公司在該權益投資中的份額為 168 百萬美元，代表 26% 的經濟權益。本公司已將對該業務的投資視為權益投資。
於 2025 年 7 月 1 日，本公司完成將可回收塑膠包裝運營部門與北美包裝解決方案供應商合併。本公司對該可回收塑膠包裝運營部門的淨資產進行去合併，並確認了 180 百萬美元的權益投資，代表對合併後業務的 45% 份額，本公司在該業務中的經濟權益為 10%。

paragraphs: 該合夥企業為註冊於百慕達的豁免有限合夥企業，依據百慕達有限合夥法 1883 年版及經修訂之百慕達豁免合夥企業法 1992 年版設立。於 2026 年 3 月 27 日，協議完成後，該合夥企業成為本公司之子公司。

該合夥企業由 Brookfield 設立，作為其商業服務及工業業務之旗艦公開合夥企業。本公司之營運主要位於美國、歐洲、澳洲、巴西及加拿大。我們專注於擁有並營運具高品質之營運，這些營運具備強勁之競爭優勢，並提供必要之產品與服務。我們透過提升各業務之現金流、採行以營運為導向之收購策略，以及適時地將營運及資產處分所產生之資金重新投資於現有營運、新收購及投資，以建立價值。在協議完成前，該合夥企業之目標為透過資本增值為單位持有人創造回報，並搭配小幅之分紅收益率。
